answer:
I rewrote the Meal plan page so it fits on an iPhone without sideways scrolling. I haven't opened it on a phone, so check it there.

The old page forced the table to a fixed 900 px width. On screens under 700 px wide, each day now shows as its own card, with Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack, Shop and Notes listed underneath. Empty cells are left out of the cards. On wider screens you still get the table, now sized to fit the width. It also uses Amber's colours, so light and dark mode follow the app.

Your note's table is unchanged, and the previous version of the page is kept if you want it back.
